answer_1.quote: In addition to the extractive span, we also allow experts to rephrase it, in order to provide an abstractive, more natural, answer.

answer_2.quote: F1 is the main evaluation metric and is computed by the overlap at word level of the prediction and reference answers.

answer_4.quote: a short survey that workers had to respond to at the end of each HIT. On the one hand, the user had to give feedback on how satisfied was with the answers of the expert in a scale of 1-5. On the other hand, the expert had to give feedback on how sensible were the questions and the helpfulness of the answers.
answer_4.guideline: Survey questions on satisfaction, sensibility of questions, and helpfulness of answers
